title: Tame  Impala Texture Pack
description: A fan-made Texture Pack for Tame Impala
body:
Important note (not very important) 

_This texture pack requires Client-Side Custom Music Disc Fix mod _

Transform your Minecraft into a psychedelic atmosphere inspired by Tame Impala. This pack redesigns the game’s visuals and music elements to create a unique, dreamy vibe while you play.

🖼️ Paintings have been replaced with Tame Impala themed visuals and album-style artwork.
🌄 Main menu panorama has been fully customized to match the aesthetic and mood of the pack.
💿 Music disc icons are redesigned with custom cover-style images.
🎵 Music discs now play different tracks to give your world a completely new sound experience.

Whether you're building, exploring, or just vibing, this pack aims to make Minecraft feel more immersive and atmospheric.

For the best experience I recommend **_Client- Side Custom Music Disc Fix_** mod but not required the reason is some musics stops 

Hope you enjoy the experience as much as I enjoyed creating it ✨
